interfaceInvariant: ProofIR evidence is ordinary public Ladon CLI behavior shared by people, scripts, editors, and models; no caller-specific command, default, threshold, or hidden evidence path is permitted.
databaseInvariant: All normalized rows use the existing repository-local proof-search SQLite database, its index override, PID lock, constraints, size limits, freshness identities, and atomic replacement lifecycle.
authorityInvariant: Catalog identity, quoted surface claims, replay runs, checker witnesses, ProofIR obligation status, declaration attachments, and Lean lineage remain separate evidence facts; none is promoted to another authority.
coverageInvariant: Configured catalog coverage and supported semantic coverage are reported separately. Unsupported, absent, stale, malformed, ambiguous, and bounded evidence cannot establish repository-wide absence or theorem truth.

dependencySemantics.startAfter: Every listed standalone change must complete its portable exit class before implementation of this child begins.
dependencySemantics.integrationDependsOn: Existing owner changes whose established contracts and artifacts this child reuses; capability identities are recorded separately in existingOwners.
dependencySemantics.enables: Later child changes allowed to start after this child's portable exit class passes.

existingOwners.ownedConcern: project-local proof-search schema, index lifecycle, locks, freshness, constraints, and query indexes
compact ProofIR input normalization and bridge authority rules
Quux Lean surface bundle and source-anchor adapters
installed process, stream, signal, representation, and exit behavior

acceptanceScenarios: surface and exact replay provenance remain separate queryable facts
missing replay provenance is not replay failure
paper-conditional and Lean-premise CDC routes preserve authority transitions
duplicate declaration candidates require compatible source evidence
the exact CDC theorem remains unattached without explicit theorem identity
two unchanged base-index builds reproduce configured ProofIR evidence
retainedExternalLanes: graph visualization and exhaustive path enumeration
